articles.summary: SALT LAKE CITY — October 6, 2026 — ReposiTrak, Inc. (NYSE: TRAK), the leader in retail supply chain, merchandising, compliance and traceability solutions, today announced the launch of a Touchless Retail™ merchandising program in a large American retailer with a national footprint, working with a national dairy CPG supplier to provide supplemental in-store merchandising coverage.
articles.title: ReposiTrak Touchless Retail™ Leads to 6% sales increase for National Dairy
